summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan — ARCA‑61 (investigation only, no changes made)  **What I did:** Traced the full watchlist path — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts` — plus the login/logout flow (`useAuth.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `LoginPage.tsx`, `Layout.tsx`).  **Headline finding: the ticket's premise doesn't fully hold up.** The parts it suspected are actually fine: - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request — cookies go out correctly. - Every watchlist route (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`) is behind an auth check t
